title: Bound lichend configuration reads before TOML parsing
description: Robustness/security review finding in rust/lichen-gateway/src/config.rs: Config::from_file uses unbounded read_to_end, so a huge regular file can exhaust daemon memory before validation. Enforce a documented maximum config size using both metadata and a take(max+1) read, then reject growth/oversize with InvalidData and test the boundary.
